title: A Verdict for the Parish
author: Wendell Coldharbour
blurb: Ulyana Eriksen, a retired detective running a failing bookshop, has spent three years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do before the trial begins.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
